name: @cratylus/canon
description: The canonical corpus of discovered semantic addresses — agents, skills, dimensions and rules as typed TS source. Markdown is a projection of these modules.
//test: `test` builds FIRST because `test/runtime-shim.test.ts` drives the shipped `cratylus project` over the repository's own `agents.config.ts`, and that config extends `@cratylus/canon` — the PACKAGE, i.e. this package's `dist`. turbo's `test.dependsOn: [^build]` builds this package's DEPENDENCIES, never this package, so a cold clone would run the consumer path against a dist that does not exist.
//: Depends on the RUNTIME contract leaf as well as forge: the memory-nudge hook cell emits shell that invokes the runtime bin, so it must read that bin's name from its one home (`@cratylus/runtime/bin-name`) rather than repeat the literal inside a compiler-invisible script string. The runtime is a zero-@cratylus-dep leaf, so the edge cannot cycle.
